static_traits.name: Li Jie
static_traits.family_status: Lives with husband, has 3 living children
static_traits.social_status: Volunteer service not yet affected; relationship with neighbors strained by inner comparison; having a supportive husband, but not yet sharing such feelings of low self-esteem with him.
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; never experienced similar problems; never received other psychotherapy or counseling.

basic_info.main_problem: I feel my sunflowers, which I am proud of, are not as good as my neighbor's. This comparison makes me feel self-inadequate and affects my self-esteem.
basic_info.core_demands: The persistent sense of inferiority and low self-esteem caused by comparison prompted me to seek counseling in order to deal with these problems.

core_beliefs: I am not as good as others

special_situations.event: At the community gardening competition, sees the neighbor's sunflowers are more vibrant and lively
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my sunflowers are not as vibrant as my neighbor's, it proves I am not good enough / I failed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries hard to avoid comparison, attempting to focus only on the positive aspects of her own spending
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My flowers are inferior to others', so I cannot do it.

special_situations.event: Whenever seeing the neighbor's sunflowers in the yard
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: My worth depends on whether my work is better than others'
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing contact with neighbors, avoiding socializing to avoid being compared
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Their flowers are better; my strengths are not worth mentioning.

special_situations.event: When doing gardening activities, tends one's own sunflowers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not the best gardener, it shows I am not good at gardening
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focusing attention on shortcomings, repeatedly self-examining mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I must have done something wrong; maybe I am simply not good at gardening.

special_situations.event: Receives praise for his sunflowers from church friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Unless my flowers are better than my neighbor's, any praise does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Dismisses positive feedback, keeps comparing with others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These compliments do not mean my flowers are good enough.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized, to have his effort and aesthetic seen
core_conflict.fear: Fears being diminished after comparison, feels ashamed
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being judged by avoiding contact with neighbors
Using rationalization to explain differences to relieve anxiety
Not expressing low self-esteem to my spouse to avoid embarrassment and not being understood

object_relations.object_representation: More superior neighbors who are potential judges

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When neighbors' more vibrant flowers are discussed or comparison topics arise
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Experiencing the neighbor as someone who judges my worth, thus feeling not good enough
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use an explanatory, rational tone, giving reasons such as 'they may have used better soil or fertilizer', downplaying emotional discussion.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether she shares feelings of inferiority with her husband
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries that expressing these feelings will seem ridiculous or be taken lightly
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Lightly avoiding deep emotional expression, using short sentences to say 'I am fine', keeping a restrained tone.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When encouraged to focus on the positive aspects of his sunflowers
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing positive feedback cannot change the fact of 'I am not good enough'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Turns to objectively describing features or technical details, avoiding the emotional level touching self-esteem.

manifestations: Avoids communicating with neighbors; used to chat often, now avoids
Not yet sharing feelings of low self-esteem with the supportive husband
Develops fear and weariness toward gardening once loved
Shifts attention from the process to results and comparison, losing personal satisfaction

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'. Language manifestations include: 'speaking of which... haha just joking', 'in theory...' and the like
manifestations: When talking about feelings, turns to discussing technical causes (such as soil, fertilizer), reducing direct touching of shame and inferiority emotions
Reducing emotional intensity through rational explanations

contact_model.definition: The individual inhibits the flow and experience of emotion, avoiding it entering consciousness or being expressed
manifestations: Not telling the husband about feelings of low self-esteem
In sessions, uses 'I think this is a bit silly' to lower the intensity of expression

exception_events.target_problem: When seeing the neighbor's sunflowers or doing gardening, the client usually makes comparisons and feels inferior with low self-esteem, then feels down and avoids interacting with the neighbor.
exception_events.unique_outcome: When volunteering at the church food pantry, he did not fall into comparison and self-deprecation as usual, but engaged in the process of helping others, feeling more stable and fulfilled.
exception_events.reason: Clue: because helping activities brought clear goals and meaning, attention shifted to others and environmental support, so comparison and Self-denial appeared less this time.

positive_force: Volunteer service provides positive engagement and a sense of meaning, able to interrupt negative thinking
Can notice and try to attend to the positive aspects of sunflowers
Willing to seek counseling to change
negative_force: Self-worth excessively dependent on external evaluation
Avoiding contact with neighbors leading to relationship tension

target_behavior.behavior: Continuously comparing with neighbors' sunflowers and self-deprecating
target_behavior.core_reason: Using comparison as the standard for self-worth evaluation, accompanied by cognitive biases such as black-and-white thinking, mental filtering, and dismissing the positive
target_behavior.function: Avoids feelings of being judged and shame; tries to gain a sense of control through self-criticism
target_behavior.consequence: Lowered self-esteem, low mood, loss of pleasure in gardening, daily mood affected

antecedent: Running into neighbors in the yard
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being compared and belittled, triggering shame and anxiety
target_behavior.function: Avoiding unwelcome emotions and potential social discomfort
